column1: # LedgerFlow OWASP ZAP Baseline Rule Configuration (SEC-SCAN-1)
# ZAP baseline uses three tab-separated fields: plugin ID, action, and its generated description.
# INFO/IGNORE apply to the entire plugin, not just URLs in the third field. See ZAP 2.16.1
# docker/zap_common.py load_config. Keep exceptions narrowly justified for the whole target.
# 10035 — Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set: the only target is an HTTP loopback
# test server, not the HTTPS edge. HSTS must still be verified separately at deployment.
# Do not suppress 10055 (CSP notices) globally: a known style-src exception cannot justify
# hiding unrelated CSP problems. Likewise 10017 must not blanket-accept all third-party
# script inclusions merely because Stripe and Plaid are expected on some pages.
